# Whitetail Electric

> Licensed and insured electrical contractor based in Columbia Falls, Montana, serving Columbia Falls, Whitefish, Kalispell and the Flathead Valley and beyond.

## Services
- Existing buildings: rewiring, upgrades, troubleshooting and service calls, panel replacements and upgrades
- New construction electrical
- Generator installation and maintenance
- Industrial and commercial electrical consulting, including PLCs

## People
- Mike Jurva, Owner and Master Electrician (30+ years in industrial, commercial and residential electrical work)
- Jayme Parrish, Apprentice Electrician
